projects.name: Erosion-SAM Project
projects.summary: The Erosion-SAM project focuses on the automatic detection of soil erosion and sedimentation in aerial imagery. Following heavy rainfall events, high-resolution aerial images were captured over affected areas, where erosion and sediment features were manually segmented. These annotated images were then used to fine-tune the Segment Anything Model (SAM) through transfer learning, addressing the common issue of limited labeled data in soil erosion research. The resulting Erosion-SAM model can accurately identify erosion and sediment features from aerial images without requiring additional training. Its outputs are valuable for training and validating machine learning models, as well as for environmental monitoring, natural resource management, and insurance assessments.
